evidence: An IDF-weighted truncated SVD of the training target-disease matrix is the first model to beat disease degree on the honest protocols.
observation: An IDF-weighted truncated SVD of the training target-disease matrix, rank-averaged over components 16/32/48/64/96 and selected on a 20% slice of training positives, scored 0.454379/0.515572 on degree-matched, 0.445564/0.516262 on hard and 0.543386/0.608806 on fair negatives. A single 16-component IDF SVD alone reached 0.405173/0.443106; recorded as F-0038.
subject: F-45
title: IDF-weighted target-disease SVD is the first model above degree
